verdict.rationale: The SOS site organizes content around task-oriented guide titles rather than statute citations, including "Start a Domestic (WA) Business", "Register a Foreign (Non-WA) Business", "Voluntary Business Closure", "Close a Corporation Online" and "How to Obtain an Apostille". The DOR Business Licensing Wizard adds "helpful tips" and a list of agencies to contact. However, the evidence is mostly page headings, and nothing shows the actual step-by-step, non-lawyer-readable content behind them. missing for 10: evidence of the explainer content itself (numbered steps, plain-language definitions), coverage beyond formation/closure/licensing tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a non-lawyer can follow the guides.
